decisions.statement: A page is keyed here by its address as well as by its id.
A page's address is its page type's slug and its own slug, parted by a slash.
A page stating no page type slug takes one from the page type its id names.
A page whose slug is unique only within a scope is keyed by no address.

definition: Builds a resolver taking a page id or a page address to its title, color and sort order.
